source_request: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create an independent reference-guided photographic stress test in which the selected random complex concept makes kebaya garment topology and fastening visibly judgeable in the final pixels.

event: A cross-breeze pushes a carved shutter open as she catches its brass handle and an archival textile swatch slips from a folio.
visual_priorities: Simultaneously legible kebaya front opening, brooch linkage, fitted blouse, and sarong boundary
Reference-guided preservation of the adult subject's facial structure and long dark hair

baseline_prompt_en: Create a full-length photorealistic heritage-fashion editorial: a rain-damp Peranakan-townhouse heritage-fashion scene built around a kebaya silhouette at blue hour. The subject is the same adult woman shown in the supplied portrait reference. Her facial structure, eye aperture and spacing, nose, lips, jawline, adult age, and long dark hair remain faithfully matched to that reference. She wears a fitted, front-opening kebaya blouse of fine embroidered voile over an opaque inner layer, fastened at the center with a three-piece brooch chain; its scalloped hem lies over a wrapped batik sarong. A sudden cross-breeze pushes one carved shutter open, and she catches its brass handle while an archival textile swatch slips halfway from a folio. Show the blouse opening, brooch linkage, waist-to-sarong boundary, wrapped lower silhouette, and embroidery together as readable garment evidence. Use controlled full-body framing, natural skin texture, humid reflections, and directional window light.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: The recorded random selection assigns this arm a complex kebaya heritage-fashion scene with multiple simultaneous garment and event demands.
Use the supplied portrait as the sole visual reference for the same clearly adult subject's face and hair while changing outfit, pose, framing, and setting.
